name: Xilonen
notes: KQM and Game8 agree on the support build: 4pc Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City (KQM: best by far), ER Sands (KQM also DEF%), DEF% Goblet, a DEF%, Healing Bonus or (KQM, with Favonius) CRIT Rate Circlet, Skill > Burst, and Peak Patrol Song first. Alternative sets: Archaic Petra (with a Geo unit), Instructor and Noblesse Oblige (KQM), Husk of Opulent Dreams (Game8's Geo DPS build, left as an option; that build runs DEF% Sands, Geo DMG Goblet and a CRIT Circlet). She scales on DEF: the Skill's Rush (179.2% to 322.6% DEF) and the Burst (281.3% DEF) are DEF-based on the elemental curve, so the damage talent is the Skill. The kit's four 'check' lines (Normal and Charged Attack, 51.8% and similar) are ATK-based base attacks on the physical curve, switching to DEF only in Blade Roller mode, and are not her damage talent. Goals: Game8 gives ER 190 or above and DEF 2,500-3,000 (upper end used); KQM's ER needs run from about 100 to 250 by team (170-190 for Solo Geo with one Skill). Partners are inferred from her elemental shred (any damage dealer).
